question: Which exact 3.101.043 callable sets LVGL label long mode, including circular scrolling for the LyraPlayer title?
callsite_evidence: Exact 3.101.043 sub_C588BF8 is a Thumb veneer to platform callable 0x1C06F15D and is called with a live label in R0 and a small long-mode enum in R1 at 955 exact-target callsites.
Exact stock helper sub_C4C8038 loads a retained label from [R0], loads enum value 3 into R1, and calls sub_C588BF8; LVGL v9 defines value 3 as LV_LABEL_LONG_SCROLL_CIRCULAR.

Exact stock create_long_label helper sub_C543748 creates a label, applies a label style, calls sub_C588BF8(label, 0), sets a fixed width, then assigns text, independently establishing the label-and-long-mode two-argument ABI.
The exact firmware contains the LVGL enum name LONG_SCROLL_CIRCULAR in its registered label API metadata.
control_flow_evidence: Working 3.101.036 sub_C588BC0 and exact 3.101.043 sub_C588BF8 have identical eight-byte Thumb veneers and both resolve to the same platform callable 0x1C06F15D.

The 3.101.036 create_long_label helper sub_C522460 and exact 3.101.043 sub_C543748 are both 0x5E bytes with identical eight-block control flow and corresponding label-create, style, long-mode, width and text calls.
The exact 3.101.043 veneer entry is 0x0C588BF8 and its Thumb callable address is 0x0C588BF9.

A targeted Corpus v2 ensemble run using only the independently proven 3.101.036 symbol ranked 0x0C588BF8 first and matched the manual 043 oracle (1/1); this validates matcher recovery but is not used as the promotion proof.
ownership_analysis: The function borrows a live LVGL label and changes only its long-mode state. It neither retains nor frees the label and must run on the firmware UI owner thread.
unsafe_assumptions: Static recovery does not replace a device gate confirming animation timing and clipping on exact 3.101.043.
The label must have a finite one-line width and height before circular scrolling can be visually bounded.
recommended_probe: Play a track with a title wider than 336 pixels on exact 3.101.043; verify one-line circular scrolling, centered short titles, fixed author placement, no overlap, and clean behavior across track changes and page teardown.

artifacts.role: exact-target long-mode veneer, circular-mode caller and long-label constructor
working-target structurally corresponding veneer and constructor
targeted Corpus v2 recovery report; independently checked against the exact-target oracle
